Chapter 953: Chapter 15 I Know a Little Bit of Everything (Please Subscribe)

In the dark grand hall.

The ultimate beings of the twelfth order gathered once again.

Compared to their full confidence a hundred years ago, the expressions on the faces of these twelfth order ultimates were not very pleasant.

A hundred years, a full century, they had personally attempted to lock down the Galaxy Master’s location using the rules of causality.

But the results were disappointing, yielding no progress; in the causal vision of every twelfth order ultimate, the Galaxy Master was indeed within the universe, but they just couldn’t pin down his location.

Had it not been certain that there was no trace of Lin Yuan’s causality within the Milky Way Main Star, some of the twelfth order ultimates would have likely made a move to test the waters.

“What exactly is going on?”

“Why is the causality sensing of the Galaxy Master so vague?”

The many twelfth order ultimates exchanged looks, considering the possibility that the Galaxy Master’s true body, his incarnations, or avatars were hiding in the Central Star Domain, the ancestral land of human civilization.

They would not be so troubled if that were the case.

After all, that is the main stronghold of human civilization.

But in fact, that’s not the case; at least, the Galaxy Master’s incarnations are often seen walking in the cosmos.

“There are two possibilities.”

The progenitor of the Tianyu Clan opened his mouth: “One is that the Galaxy Master’s mastery over the rules of causality surpasses us, the twelfth order. Only then could he conceal his own causality, leading us to repeatedly come back empty-handed.”

“The second possibility is that the Galaxy Master is relying on a treasured causality artifact to isolate his own causality. With the resources of human civilization, producing such an artifact would not be difficult.”

After saying this, the Tianyu Clan progenitor pondered for a while before continuing: “I think the second possibility is more likely.”

Hearing this, the other twelfth order ultimates nodded in agreement.

The Galaxy Master surpassing them in causality? That possibility was too fantastical to imagine; after all, they were beings of the twelfth order! Even if they were not adept in causality, they wouldn’t be surpassed by an eleventh order.

“It’s a pity that we do not have any of his blood or hair as a lead; otherwise, even with a causality artifact for protection, he could not escape our causality tracking,” the Ultimate from the Prison Tribe said, shaking his head slightly.

The rule of causality values the ‘medium’ greatly, whether in cursing or in locating a target, having a ‘medium’ and not having one are completely different challenges.

“With the strength and realm of the Galaxy Master, along with how much human civilization values him, it’s impossible for any of his blood or hair to be left outside,” said the Insect Queen.

“Even for an ordinary eleventh order, they would be quite cautious about this, not leaving behind anything related to themselves outside.”

Even on the battlefield, high-order powerhouses would detonate themselves without hesitation if they found no way to survive, turning their body, soul, and all related materials to ashes.

This action is not only to prevent being captured by alien races but also out of concern that alien races could obtain their ‘medium’ through their remains.

“It seems we can’t find the Galaxy Master through normal methods,” reflected the Ultimate from the Prison Tribe. “Is there a way to force the Galaxy Master out?”

The so-called forcing out involved threatening with the lives of the Galaxy Master’s relatives and friends to coerce him into appearing.

The Galaxy Master is quite young, with all his relatives still alive, including many elders, such as the various Peak Masters and the Chikun Star Lord of the Red Kun Lineage.

“It’s not very meaningful.”

The Ultimate from the Star Alliance shook his head, “The Galaxy Master is not the kind to overly value emotions and family.”

“Indeed.”

The Insect Queen nodded, “Tuoba Ancient God originally planned to use the Galaxy Master’s friend as a threat, but the Galaxy Master personally killed that friend.”

The twelfth order ultimates present in the hall had all thoroughly investigated the Galaxy Master and naturally were aware of the conflict with the Tuoba Ancient God.

Seeing how the Galaxy Master dealt with Tuoba Ancient God, they estimated that even if they captured the Galaxy Master’s relatives or teacher, the Galaxy Master would likely not even frown over it.

And for ultimates of the twelfth order to descend into such actions, it would indeed be somewhat disgraceful if the means used were ineffective, besides that, they would have to face retribution from the most powerful beings of human civilization afterwards.

It’s just not worth it.

“Lord Fan.” At this moment, the Ultimate from the Prison Tribe turned to the Ultimate from the Cosmos Clan, “Your clan received a special secret technique at the dawn of the cosmos…”

“You?” The countenance of the Cosmos Clan Ultimate Lord Fan shifted ever so slightly. “Are you talking about the Secret Technique ‘Nine-day Worship’?”

‘Nine-day Worship’…it is a secret technique within the domain of the causality rules. It involves a worshipping ritual that forcibly strengthens the causal link between two entities, ultimately for cursing or pinpointing one’s location.

However, this secret technique comes at a great cost. To use it against the Galaxy Master, one must worship the Galaxy Master for nine consecutive days, with each day resulting in a reduction of the caster’s Origin Source.

While the reduced Origin Source can be restored later, it requires a significant amount of time, and during this period, one’s battle capacity cannot be at its peak.

If it were to subdue a peer ultimate, the Cosmos Clan Ultimate Lord Fan might be willing, but to merely locate the position of the Galaxy Master requires paying so much of his own Origin Source?

“The Galaxy Master is already at the peak of Level Eleven, any moment ready to break through to the ultimate level. Once he steps into the twelfth order, there is a high probability that he will become a pinnacle being of the Path Splitting Realm before the end of the Cosmic Era.”

“By then, you should know what will happen with our races,” the Ultimate from the Prison Tribe said.

“Lord Fan, to counter the Galaxy Master, everyone is willing to offer that drop of Heterogeneous Blood, allowing you to cast the secret technique. What’s stopping you?” the Insect Queen interjected.

If considering the price to be paid, the Insect Race has indeed offered the highest stake.

Nevertheless, the Insect Race holds the deepest grudge against human civilization and is the least willing to see the Galaxy Master successfully ascend to the twelfth order.

“I understand.”

After pondering for a while, the Cosmos Clan Ultimate Lord Fan nodded, “I will begin worshipping the Galaxy Master now. Nine days from now, my causal link with the Galaxy Master will be at its strongest, and then I will inform you all of his specific location.”
